name: ...in white
source:
6 x 6 = 36
36 x 4 = 144

Locked away in an altogether strange room of sheer white,
Yuki passed her days counting the bolts in the ceiling.
Out of nowhere, the speaker declared the being of "another subject" ...

突然，扬声器宣告了“另一个实验体”的存在……
